meta.name: coding-agent-sessions
meta.description: MUST USE when asked to find, read, list, search, inspect, fetch, export, or reconstruct coding-agent sessions across Codex, Claude Code/Desktop, OpenCode, OMO/Senpi/pi, oh-my-pi (omp), gajae-code (gjc), OpenClaw, Factory Droid, Amp, Gemini/Kimi/Qwen CLIs, Codebuff, Roo/Kilo/Cline, Kodu, Cursor CLI, Aider, Aside browser-agent sessions, or unknown local agent logs. Covers transcripts, session IDs, rollout JSONL, state SQLite, Claude projects/pre-compact histories, OpenCode messages/parts, child/subagent linkage, cwd/model/time/token filters, archives, and cost clues. Expands fuzzy recall into parallel query lanes and first probes known stores so absent platforms are skipped cheaply. Triggers: coding agent sessions, Codex/Claude/OpenCode/OMO/Senpi/pi/oh-my-pi/omp/gajae-code/gjc/OpenClaw/Droid/Amp/Kodu/Cursor/Aider/Aside sessions, transcript search, session history, session ID, read transcript, token usage, subagent sessions, what did I do yesterday, did we already do this.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并重建多款编码工具的历史会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常用多个编码助手且记不清当时是怎么实现的
copy.tagline_en: Find and reconstruct past coding agent sessions across many tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you juggle multiple coding agents and often lose track of what happened.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先搜索你电脑上各编程助手(如 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等)留下的会话记录,再回答你关于“之前做过什么”的问题。它能按平台、日期、目录、模型等筛选,还能列出每个主会话下的子任务,并读取具体会话内容作为证据。
howto.when: 当你说“查找/查看/搜索某个编程助手的会话记录”时触发,涉及 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等平台;当你问“前几天我做了什么”“之前是否做过某事”这类记忆问题时也会触发。

say.text: 查一下我昨天用 Codex 做了哪些事
say.note: Claude 会搜索 Codex 会话并列出当天的记录。

say.text: 找到上次修复 OpenCode bug 的会话
say.note: Claude 会扩展查询词并搜索相关会话。

say.text: 把最近一周所有编程助手的会话整理出来
say.note: Claude 会按时间范围搜索多个平台并汇总。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude searches local coding-agent session logs (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, etc.) before answering memory questions. It filters by platform/date/dir/model, lists subagent sessions, and reads specific sessions as evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to find/view/search coding-agent sessions (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, etc.), or when you ask memory questions like "what did I do yesterday" or "did we already do this".

say_en.text: Look up what I did with Codex yesterday
say_en.note: Claude searches Codex sessions and lists that day's records.

say_en.text: Find the session where we fixed the OpenCode bug
say_en.note: Claude expands the query and searches relevant sessions.

say_en.text: Summarize all coding-agent sessions from the last week
say_en.note: Claude searches across platforms by time range and merges results.
